Topic 5.2: Paper folding

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Paper folding. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify materials for paper folding
2. Make items using folding techniques for enjoyment
3. Appreciate paper folding for fun display their work 91

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify materials for paper folding
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify materials for paper folding. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Make items using folding techniques for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to make items using folding techniques for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate paper folding for fun display their work 91
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate paper folding for fun display their work 91. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Paper folding.
2. Explain Paper folding to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Guide learners Identify materials 1. What items do you enjoy leaner should be able to: for paper folding making? 3 Lessons 2. Which ways do you fold
4. Show that you can: Identify materials for paper folding
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Paper folding. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Paper folding important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
